title: Imaginar la nación
goal: Read a closing thesis on nationalism: neither an eternal truth nor a simple lie, but a real historical invention with real consequences.

items: Explain whether being an 'imagined community' makes a nation less real or legitimate.
State how the reading proposes nationalism should be studied.
Recall the four concrete pieces of nation-building covered across the unit.
Explain what nationalism becomes once understood this way, rather than as a mere backdrop.
Combine relative clauses, contrast and passive structures into an integrated thesis statement.
